# Gridfinity Rebuilt source

These files are copied from [kennetek/gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad](https://github.com/kennetek/gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad) at commit [`910e22d8607fd7f5f51ad5e5cbc5287a76810bfd`](https://github.com/kennetek/gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad/tree/910e22d8607fd7f5f51ad5e5cbc5287a76810bfd).

Only the `src` tree used by this project and the upstream `LICENSE` are included. The files are unmodified. Preserve `LICENSE` when redistributing them; it contains the upstream Gridfinity Rebuilt and Gridfinity notices. `src/external/threads-scad/threads.scad` identifies Ryan A. Colyer as author and declares CC0 in its header.

To update the bundled source, copy the corresponding `src` files and `LICENSE` from a single upstream commit, update the commit above and in the root README, then run the OpenSCAD render check.
